description: This file defines the class OCIContainerImplementation, which implements container management functionalities such as starting, stopping, and querying containers, as well as handling container events. It includes interface implementations, nested classes, and event handling mechanisms within the WPEFramework plugin namespace.

classes.name: OCIContainerImplementation
classes.description: Implements container lifecycle management and event handling within the WPEFramework plugin architecture, including methods for container operations and event notifications.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A nested class representing a dispatchable job associated with container events, managing references to the parent OCIContainerImplementation and executing dispatch logic.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for container events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: ListContainers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of current containers.

methods.name: GetContainerInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific container.

methods.name: GetContainerState
methods.description: Gets the current state of a specified container.

methods.name: StartContainer
methods.description: Starts a container with specified parameters.

methods.name: StartContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Starts a container using a Dobby specification.

methods.name: StopContainer
methods.description: Stops a running container.

methods.name: PauseContainer
methods.description: Pauses a running container.

methods.name: ResumeContainer
methods.description: Resumes a paused container.

methods.name: HibernateContainer
methods.description: Hibernates a container with specified options.

methods.name: WakeupContainer
methods.description: Wakes up a hibernated container.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container.

methods.name: Annotate
methods.description: Adds an annotation key-value pair to a container.

methods.name: RemoveAnnotation
methods.description: Removes an annotation from a container.

methods.name: Mount
methods.description: Mounts a filesystem source to a container.

methods.name: Unmount
methods.description: Unmounts a filesystem from a container.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Handles container started event.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Handles container stopped event.

methods.name: onContainerFailed
methods.description: Handles container failure event.

methods.name: onContainerStateChange
methods.description: Handles container state change event.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a container event to registered notifications.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Internal method to dispatch events based on event type.
